manufacture.title: From Idea to Export
manufacture.privateLabelBody: To manufacture your product to your specification — not to manufacture a generic product and put your label on it.
manufacture.intro: Every order moves through the same ten stages. Nothing is skipped, and nothing is handed to the next stage until the previous one is signed off.

contact.title: Tell us what you want to manufacture
contact.intro: Whether you are developing a new collection, launching a private label, expanding an existing product line or looking for a long-term manufacturing partner, our team is ready to review your requirements.
contact.moqNote: Flexible depending on product, fabric and production requirements.
contact.upload: Upload tech pack or reference files
contact.uploadHint: PDF, AI, XLSX, JPG, PNG · up to 25 MB each

contact.nextThree: We develop the sample, then move into bulk production once you approve it.
